text_block_list.name: Japanese Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A historic breakthrough for Japan, who had never won before!
A URA-affiliated Umamusume has finally claimed her first BC victory!"

text_block_list.name: Local Radio Show
text_block_list.text:
"This is a stunning surprise...!
Pushing past the powerhouse who seemed unbeatable this year as well, the one to seize the dream is a Japanese Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooooh! Tazuna! Did you see that?!
I won! I won! Mwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
With this, the feelings of everyone who supported us will be rewarded...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in "DREAMS"!
Let's take a photo, a photo!
choice_data_list: Casino Drive. Here, let me put this lei on you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wait, but this is—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're the hero of this PJ.
So think of this as a special reward, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... How do you feel?
What are your honest thoughts right now?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, it's very...
heavy, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heavy...?
Is it really that heavy?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It carries the weight of a dream pursued endlessly
by countless Umamusume and their supporters.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Those who seized their dreams, and those who couldn't...
Upon these shoulders, I truly feel the weight of history woven by all their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If only I had acquired more...
—No, enough of that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look look, Ms. Casino.
Look over here too, please♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "For the stream, you see♪"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Today is a turning point for Japan, and for me.
Let us savor this momentous victory together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, Japan claimed its first-ever Breeders' Cup victory, sending shockwaves through the news—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the months and days passed by—

text_block_list.name: Hardworking Morning Practice Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Traaaceeen!
Fight, oh! Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that BC victory, I can truly feel
the entire racing world's drive to challenge the BC surging.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The same went for the Umamusume who joined the team.
The members of "DREAMS" had begun taking steps into their new days.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh!
I'm definitely winning the next race.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Do not think you can win so easily
on my home turf.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "If you win... I wouldn't mind treating you to sauce ramen."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You just want to promote the local food, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting their sights on domestic GⅠ races as the next goal,
accumulating victories to advance even further.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I have realized that further trials are necessary
for me to reach 'that place.' Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Journeying across the world as a Saint to reach even greater heights—
I feel something truly fateful, especially about Dubai!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. If it is a journey for one with great ambitions,
our committee will spare no support.
Now then, right this way—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone who dashes onward toward an even greater dream,
one that surpasses reality itself.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
A-Another try...?
Y-You're entering again next year...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Right! Because we didn't manage to achieve an "undefeated team sweep" this year, did we?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if we take this experience and use it to lead the next 'DREAMS', I know we can do it!
Our love will reach even more people!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. When you say it, Love-chan,
it somehow feels like we really can pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those who walk together, striving to see their dream through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What should I do~?
Let's see if there are any interesting races...

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
T-This is an offer from a public institution, after all.
Please don't make your choice too lightly...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, really—
I am taking this seriously, ya know~♪"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
What's important is whether this has the potential
to impact the Japanese racing scene.
If we're doing this, we have to create value there.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If I keep winning like that,
Japanese races are gonna be way more exciting!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I might be able to change all the things
that have been stalled, too!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Don'tcha wanna see an insanely fun world? Then we've just gotta spark an innovation, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One who brings about revolution in the racing world
precisely as they desire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each of them looks forward, heading toward the future.
And—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I'm honored that you came to see me off.
choice_data_list: Because we're comrades who chased the same dream.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Comrades... Yes, comrades is precisely what we are.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"In the sense that we all aimed for the BC,
perhaps we were comrades even before forming this team."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That is why—I swear that when I challenge it once more,
I will be sure to invite you, my comrade.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Until then, I will learn more
about overseas athlete training environments."
choice_data_list: I'll scout plenty of promising runners beforehand.
I'll find plenty of promising athletes for you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
And let's meet again someday!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: To chase a great dream together!
